question.problem:
$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}^{′}(t)=2{x}_{1}(t)-2{x}_{2}(t) \\ {x}_{2}^{′}(t)=-{x}_{1}(t)+3{x}_{2}(t),\end{aligned}\,x(0)=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 3\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the initial value problem above. By applying the Laplace transform $L$ to both sides of each equation in our system, we get a system with variables ${X}_{1}(s)=L\{{x}_{1}(t)\}$ and ${X}_{2}(s)=L\{{x}_{2}(t)\}.$ In terms of the parameter $s,$ the solution of the new system is

${X}_{1}(s)=\frac{2(2s-9)}{(s-1)(s-4)},\,{X}_{2}(s)=$ {{field-1}}.
question.worked_solution:
First, we find the Laplace transforms of both sides of each equation in our system:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}L\{{x}_{1}^{′}(t)\}=L\{2{x}_{1}(t)-2{x}_{2}(t)\} \\ L\{{x}_{2}^{′}(t)\}=L\{-{x}_{1}(t)+3{x}_{2}(t)\}\end{aligned}\,\,
$$

Using the derivative property of the Laplace transform, we obtain the system

$$
\{\begin{aligned}sL\{{x}_{1}(t)\}-{x}_{1}(0)=2L\{{x}_{1}(t)\}-2L\{{x}_{2}(t)\} \\ sL\{{x}_{2}(t)\}-{x}_{2}(0)=-L\{{x}_{1}(t)\}+3L\{{x}_{2}(t)\}\end{aligned}
$$

which can be simplified to the following:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}s{X}_{1}(s)-4=2{X}_{1}(s)-2{X}_{2}(s) \\ s{X}_{2}(s)-3=-{X}_{1}(s)+3{X}_{2}(s)\end{aligned}
$$

where ${X}_{1}(s)=L\{{x}_{1}(t)\}$ and ${X}_{2}(s)=L\{{x}_{2}(t)\}.$

Rewriting the system in standard form, we get the following:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}(s-2){X}_{1}(s)+2{X}_{2}(s)=4 \\ {X}_{1}(s)+(s-3){X}_{2}(s)=3\end{aligned}
$$

Now, from the second equation, we have 

$$
{X}_{1}(s)=3-(s-3){X}_{2}(s).
$$

Substituting this into the first equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}(s-2)[3-(s-3){X}_{2}(s)]+2{X}_{2}(s) & =4 \\ 3(s-2)-[(s-2)(s-3)-2]{X}_{2}(s) & =4 \\ -({s}^{2}-5s+4){X}_{2}(s) & =4-3(s-2) \\ -(s-1)(s-4){X}_{2}(s) & =-3s+10 \\ {X}_{2}(s) & =\frac{3s-10}{(s-1)(s-4)}.\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we find ${X}_{1}(s):$

$$
\begin{aligned}{X}_{1}(s) & =3-(s-3){X}_{2}(s) \\  & =3-(s-3)\cdot \frac{3s-10}{(s-1)(s-4)} \\  & =\frac{3(s-1)(s-4)-(s-3)(3s-10)}{(s-1)(s-4)} \\  & =\frac{4s-18}{(s-1)(s-4)} \\  & =\frac{2(2s-9)}{(s-1)(s-4)}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
{X}_{1}(s)=\frac{2(2s-9)}{(s-1)(s-4)},\,{X}_{2}(s)=\frac{3s-10}{(s-1)(s-4)}.
$$
